limitations: Attempts are in-memory, as in the existing OAuth store; restart requires retry but canonical grants remain readable.
ON-B-11 must provide authenticated callback routing and immutable owner-bound services, serialize legacy/onboarding exchanges to a canonical store, and map missing services to unsupported.
Hosted current configuration does not expose a trusted public OAuth client ID for this verifier. Activation requires authoritative injection; no secret/API-key form is added.
Managed handoff cannot prove local attempt provenance; verified hosted grants have attemptId null and never advance a journey automatically.
ON-U-10 must use bounded mutation transport calls, wire controlled UI callbacks, respect streamId/revision and replace pending UI on controller failure.
No real-provider or native browser verification; actual combined D/F/Q assembly is not present.

Local legacy api-google-oauth.test.ts was not run because its default token-path fixture is not reliably isolated; the new integration fixture exercises the same real exchange/store with an explicit temporary path. Full CI runs the legacy suite in its disposable runner.
rollback: Omit/disable google-state.v1 registration and use the unchanged legacy path. Retain canonical grants, journey records and drafts. Do not revoke or delete connection data as a rollback effect.
